Based on Vamsi's resume and project documentation, his strongest project is the **Retail Support AI Agent**. 

Here is why it stands out:
- **Rigorous Engineering & Testing:** It features schema-validated tool calling, explicit policy guardrails, and a human-handoff circuit breaker implemented in code—backed by an extensive test suite of 51 Pytest tests.
- **Data-Driven Iteration:** Vamsi built a tau-bench-style evaluation framework comprising 12 multi-turn scenarios graded on final database state. Using this setup, he iterated prompts through the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) to measurably improve performance, raising task success from 75% to 100% and escalation accuracy from 83% to 100%.
